match_note: v1 still contains the items the rebuttal says were changed: 'unique combination' wording, mixed 'LBCO-1/8'/'LBCO-0.125' naming, and none of the references added in revision (Agrestini/Bianconi, Campi, J. Phys. Soc. Jpn. 73, 1123, PRL 86, 500, Nat. Commun. 11, 3323) or the 0.7% strain estimate; the cited figures (Figs. 1c-d, 2d, 3c-f, 4a) match.

concerns.quote: In Figure 1d, the phase labeled "3D SC" is shown adjacent to "LTLO". Is this a typo? Should it be "LTT" instead?
concerns.summary: The LTLO label in the Fig. 1d phase diagram may be wrong.

concerns.quote: Since the μSR, AC susceptibility, and electrical resistivity measurements were all performed on the same sample piece, this point could be emphasized in the abstract.
concerns.summary: Suggests stating in the abstract that all probes used the same sample.

concerns.quote: Why do the μSR and AC susceptibility data only extend up to 0.23 GPa? Would it be possible to measure up to around 0.5 GPa?
concerns.summary: Asks for μSR and susceptibility data up to 0.5 GPa to strengthen the Fig. 4a phase diagram.

concerns.quote: reported experimental evidence for the "3D (temperature, doping, strain) i.e., (temperature, density, and pressure) superconducting dome which was proposed may years ago
concerns.summary: Asks the authors to cite earlier proposals of a strain-tuned 3D superconducting dome and the stripe critical point.

concerns.quote: moves to the underdoped doping which was recently observed in artificial high Tc superlattices of LCO-LSCO quantum wells
concerns.summary: Asks for citation of related results in LCO-LSCO superlattices.

concerns.quote: Can the authors include an illustration of the LTLO phase together with LTT, LTO, and HTT phases?
concerns.summary: Requests an illustration of the LTLO structure alongside the other phases in Fig. 1b.

concerns.quote: the annotation in Fig. 1c implies that the 2D SC occurs simultaneously as the spin-stripe order sets in below ~40 K. I think the sketch here is somewhat misleading
concerns.summary: The Fig. 1c sketch misrepresents the 2D superconducting onset relative to stripe ordering, and T_SO is not defined.

concerns.quote: the peak height of LBCO-0.125 does not appear to be zero for 0.48 GPa and above, although it is "set to zero" as stated in the caption to Fig. 3.
concerns.summary: The resistivity peak-height definition and normalization in Fig. 3d-f are unclear and appear inconsistent with the data.

concerns.quote: Is the inference of co-existing spin-stripe order and 3D SO at high stress values >0.23 GPa experimentally justified (Fig. 4a)?
concerns.summary: The leveling-off of magnetic volume fraction and coexistence at high stress rest on too few data points.

concerns.quote: Can the authors relate the stress applied to uniaxial strain?
concerns.summary: Asks for an estimate of the strain corresponding to the applied stress.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: I find it somewhat unreasonable to refer to the combination of μSR, AC susceptibility experiment as "unique".
concerns.summary: Objects to calling the multi-probe combination 'unique'.

concerns.quote: the terms "LBCO-1/8" and "LBCO-0.125" are used interchangeably.
concerns.summary: Sample naming should be consistent.

concerns.quote: Do the authors think the charge component could be decoupled from the spin component when stress is applied?
concerns.summary: 'Stripe order' and 'spin-stripe order' are used interchangeably without justification.

concerns.quote: How is \chi_AC calculated? It appears to be normalized with respect to the max. magnitude at each stress value, but it is not stated in the manuscript.
concerns.summary: The normalization of the AC susceptibility is not stated.

concerns.quote: Fig. 2d: Why is there no data for 0.09 GPa above 33 K?
concerns.summary: Data for 0.09 GPa above 33 K appear missing in Fig. 2d.

concerns.quote: the manuscript appears to overlap substantially with the authors' previous work on nearby dopings, especially Refs. 6 and 20.
concerns.summary: Novelty relative to the authors' earlier stress studies on nearby dopings is unclear.

concerns.quote: the broader context of symmetry-breaking strain/stress studies in stripe cuprates should be discussed more carefully.
concerns.summary: Earlier uniaxial-stress, optical and in-plane-field studies of La-214 stripe cuprates are not discussed.

concerns.quote: The disappearance of the normal-state resistance peak is interpreted as suppression of the LTT phase, but this is an indirect structural proxy.
concerns.summary: Resistivity is an indirect probe of the LTT phase; a direct comparison with diffraction for x=0.125 is needed.

concerns.quote: μSR can establish a reduction of the static magnetic volume fraction on its characteristic timescale, but it cannot directly demonstrate that the remaining nonmagnetic fraction hosts dynamic stripes
concerns.summary: Conversion to dynamic stripes enhancing pairing is speculative; reduced frustration, phase coherence or connectivity could explain the data.

concerns.quote: whether the differences in T_c among the different dopings could partly arise from differences in crystal quality, strain homogeneity, contact geometry, or sample-dependent disorder.
concerns.summary: Tc differences across dopings and step-like R(T) features may be sample-quality artifacts; reproducibility and multiple samples are requested.

concerns.quote: Otherwise, the statement "highest bulk T_c in the 214 family" may be too strong.
concerns.summary: Different Tc definitions are compared; the claim of exceeding optimal LSCO Tc needs a specified criterion.
